examples.chinese: 這個網站上的圖片很多，而且都很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn shàng de túpiàn hěn duō, érqiě dōu hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: There are many pictures on this website, and they all look great.

items.wordHook: A 圖(picture) on a 片(flat piece) is a 圖片(picture/photo).

examples.chinese: 請不要把貼紙貼在教室的桌子上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bùyào bǎ tiēzhǐ tiē zài jiàoshì de zhuōzi shàng.
examples.english: Please don't stick stickers on the classroom desks.

examples.chinese: 我想要得到便利商店的貼紙，所以花了很多錢買東西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào dédào biànlì shāngdiàn de tiēzhǐ, suǒyǐ huā le hěn duō qián mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: I wanted to get the convenience store stickers, so I spent a lot of money buying things.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.
examples.english: Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo. Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags. On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn tiēxīn, zhǐyào kèrén yī shàngmén, lìkè tígōng miànzhǐ gěi kèrén cā shǒu.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very considerate; as soon as customers come in, they immediately provide tissues for them to wipe their hands.

examples.chinese: 公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de bùgào shàng tiēzhe chāoshì dǎzhé huódòng de guǎnggào, gǎnjué zhēn de hěn guài.
examples.english: The company's notice has an ad for a supermarket discount event posted on it; it feels really strange.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: 華人過春節時有個風俗，就是每戶人家都會在門口貼春聯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén guò Chūnjié shí yǒu ge fēngsú, jiùshì měi hù rénjiā dōu huì zài ménkǒu tiē chūnlián.
examples.english: When Chinese people celebrate Spring Festival, there is a custom: every household will paste spring couplets at the door.

examples.chinese: 筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

examples.chinese: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important.

examples.chinese: 這家超市賣的商品都是安全的，讓顧客買得安心、吃得安心，用的也安心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì mài de shāngpǐn dōu shì ānquán de, ràng gùkè mǎi de ānxīn, chī de ānxīn, yòng de yě ānxīn.
examples.english: The products sold at this supermarket are all safe, allowing customers to buy with peace of mind, eat with peace of mind, and use with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shūdiàn gòumǎi shāngpǐn, gùkè děi xiān huìkuǎn. Yībān gòuwù wǎngzhàn dōu shì děng shōudào gùkè de huìkuǎn hòu, cái jìchū shāngpǐn de.
examples.english: To purchase products at this online bookstore, customers must first remit money. Generally, shopping websites all wait until they have received the customer's remittance before they send out the products.

examples.chinese: 購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù wǎngzhàn huì bǎ chángjiàn de gòuwù wèntí jí chǔlǐ fāngshì fàng zài wǎngyè shàng, tígōng gěi gùkè cānkǎo.
examples.english: Shopping websites will put commonly seen shopping problems and how to handle them on their web pages, providing them for customers' reference.

examples.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí, zhùmíng diǎnxīn diàn dōu huì shōudào dàliàng de dìngdān, shènzhì yǒu gùkè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìngdān le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year, famous pastry shops receive a large number of orders; some customers even place orders half a year in advance.

examples.chinese: 顧客付了錢，賣家也交了貨，這樣子交易才算完成。
examples.pinyin: Gùkè fù le qián, màijiā yě jiāo le huò, zhèyàngzi jiāoyì cái suàn wánchéng.
examples.english: The customer has paid, and the seller has delivered the goods; only then is the transaction considered complete.

examples.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
examples.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 在處理那位顧客的問題上，餐廳的態度真令我失望。
examples.pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ nà wèi gùkè de wèntí shàng, cāntīng de tàidù zhēn lìng wǒ shīwàng.
examples.english: In handling that customer's problem, the restaurant's attitude really disappointed me.

examples.chinese: 對顧客來說，品牌代表了對公司服務的印象以及商品的品質。
examples.pinyin: Duì gùkè lái shuō, pǐnpái dàibiǎo le duì gōngsī fúwù de yìnxiàng yǐjí shāngpǐn de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: For customers, a brand represents the impression of the company's service as well as the quality of the product.

examples.chinese: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn shícháng zài guòjié shí jǔbàn jiàngjià huódòng lái xīyǐn gùkè.
examples.english: Online stores often hold discount events during festivals to attract customers.

examples.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
examples.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

examples.chinese: 在古代，國王所說的話是絕對的，也是最高的命令。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, guówáng suǒ shuō de huà shì juéduì de, yě shì zuì gāo de mìnglìng.
examples.english: In ancient times, what the king said was absolute and also the highest command.

examples.chinese: 國王命下面的人死，那些人就非死不可。
examples.pinyin: Guówáng mìng xiàmiàn de rén sǐ, nàxiē rén jiù fēi sǐ bùkě.
examples.english: If the king ordered the people below to die, those people had no choice but to die.

examples.chinese: 故事中的女主角吻了白馬一下，白馬就變成了英俊的國王。
examples.pinyin: Gùshì zhōng de nǚzhǔjiǎo wěn le báimǎ yīxià, báimǎ jiù biànchéng le yīngjùn de guówáng.
examples.english: The female protagonist in the story kissed the white horse once, and the white horse turned into a handsome king.

examples.chinese: 看病以前要先掛號，再照號碼進去看醫生。病人得先掛了號才可以看病。
examples.pinyin: Kànbìng yǐqián yào xiān guàhào, zài zhào hàomǎ jìnqù kàn yīshēng. Bìngrén děi xiān guà le hào cái kěyǐ kànbìng.
examples.english: Before seeing a doctor, you must first register, then go in according to your number to see the doctor. Patients must first register before they can see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 寄掛號信雖然貴了一點兒，可是比較可靠。
examples.pinyin: Jì guàhàoxìn suīrán guì le yīdiǎnr, kěshì bǐjiào kěkào.
examples.english: Although sending a registered letter is a bit more expensive, it is more reliable.

examples.chinese: 為了給孩子幸福的生活，很多父母一輩子都努力地工作。王先生這輩子沒結婚，他希望下輩子會有機會。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gěi háizi xìngfú de shēnghuó, hěn duō fùmǔ yíbèizi dōu nǔlì de gōngzuò. Wáng xiānsheng zhè bèizi méi jiéhūn, tā xīwàng xià bèizi huì yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: In order to give their children a happy life, many parents work hard their whole life. Mr. Wang hasn't married in this lifetime; he hopes he will have a chance in the next life.

examples.chinese: 陳先生在醫院裡著急地等待小孩出生。有些人等待了一輩子，都等不到高升的機會。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng zài yīyuàn lǐ zháojí de děngdài xiǎohái chūshēng. Yǒuxiē rén děngdài le yíbèizi, dōu děng bú dào gāoshēng de jīhuì.
examples.english: Mr. Chen is anxiously waiting in the hospital for his child to be born. Some people wait their whole life and never get a chance for promotion.

examples.chinese: 不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang yǒu duō xīnkǔ, dōu shì wǒmen yībèizi zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: No matter how hard the road of pursuing dreams is, it is all precious memories for a lifetime.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 他把存了半輩子的錢都拿去做生意，結果生意不成功，錢都沒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ cún le bànbèizi de qián dōu ná qù zuò shēngyì, jiéguǒ shēngyì bù chénggōng, qián dōu méi le.
examples.english: He took all the money he had saved for half his life to do business, but the business was unsuccessful, and all the money was gone.

examples.chinese: 有人花大半輩子的時間工作，陪親人的時間卻非常少。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén huā dàbàn bèizi de shíjiān gōngzuò, péi qīnrén de shíjiān què fēicháng shǎo.
examples.english: Some people spend more than half their lifetime working, yet the time they spend with their family is very little.

examples.chinese: 人生短短幾十年，一輩子很快就過去了，因此應該活得精彩、過得有意義。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yībèizi hěn kuài jiù guòqù le, yīncǐ yīnggāi huó de jīngcǎi, guò de yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: Life is only a short few decades; a lifetime passes quickly, so one should live splendidly and meaningfully.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 我有一個幸福美滿的家庭，父母都很愛我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge xìngfú měimǎn de jiātíng, fùmǔ dōu hěn ài wǒ.
examples.english: I have a happy and fulfilling family; my parents both love me very much.

examples.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，只要滿兩千塊，就送一盤水果。那個杯子裡裝滿了水。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, zhǐyào mǎn liǎngqiān kuài, jiù sòng yī pán shuǐguǒ. Nàge bēizi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ.
examples.english: At this restaurant, as long as you reach 2,000 dollars, they give you a plate of fruit. That cup is full of water.

examples.chinese: 那家印尼餐廳常常客滿，你最好先打電話訂位。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìnní cāntīng chángcháng kèmǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
examples.english: That Indonesian restaurant is often full; you'd better call ahead to make a reservation.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的菜又便宜又好吃，所以假日常常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī, suǒyǐ jiàrì chángcháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: That restaurant's food is both cheap and delicious, so it is often fully occupied on holidays.

examples.chinese: 老師很滿意大家這次期中考的成績。這次期中考，大家都考得很好，老師覺得很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì dàjiā zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo de chéngjī. Zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo, dàjiā dōu kǎo de hěn hǎo, lǎoshī juéde hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese: 透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò jiàoshòu de jièshào, wǒ yī bìyè jiù shùnlì de zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Through the professor's introduction, I smoothly found a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
examples.pinyin: Huālián nà jǐ jiā lǚguǎn de shuāngrén kèfáng dōu kèmǎn le, wǒmen háishì dìng mínsù ba.
examples.english: The double guest rooms at those hotels in Hualien are all fully booked; we'd better book a homestay instead.

examples.chinese: 週末的時候，火車站的賣票窗口總是排滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, huǒchēzhàn de mài piào chuāngkǒu zǒngshì pái mǎn le rén.
examples.english: On weekends, the ticket windows at the train station are always fully lined up with people.

examples.chinese: 按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào shāngpǐn mùlù de shuōmíng, xiāofèi mǎn wǔbǎi yuán kěyǐ dǎ bāwǔzhé.
examples.english: According to the product catalog, if you spend 500 yuan, you can get a 15% discount.

examples.chinese: 小王對農業很有興趣，家裡的倉庫擺滿了種田用的工具。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng duì nóngyè hěn yǒu xìngqù, jiālǐ de cāngkù bǎi mǎn le zhòngtián yòng de gōngjù.
examples.english: Xiao Wang is very interested in agriculture; the warehouse at home is filled with tools for farming.

examples.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 元旦那天因為不少人放假，大部分餐廳都客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Yuándàn nà tiān yīnwèi bù shǎo rén fàngjià, dà bùfèn cāntīng dōu kèmǎn le.
examples.english: On New Year's Day, because many people had the day off, most restaurants were full.

examples.chinese: 這處風景區非常有名，假日都擠滿了遊客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chù fēngjǐngqū fēicháng yǒumíng, jiàrì dōu jǐ mǎn le yóukè.
examples.english: This scenic area is very famous; on holidays it is crowded with tourists.

examples.chinese: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bù mǎnyì wǒmen zhè yì zǔ de bàogào, yào wǒmen chóng zuò yí cì.
examples.english: The teacher is not satisfied with our group's report and wants us to do it again.

examples.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
examples.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ bàngōngshì gézhe bōlí wǎng wài kàn, kěyǐ kànjiàn kāi mǎn xiānhuā de huāyuán.
examples.english: Looking out through the glass from my office, I can see a garden full of blooming flowers.

examples.chinese: 這家旅行社有宣傳活動，所以裡頭、外頭都站滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu xuānchuán huódòng, suǒyǐ lǐtou, wàitou dōu zhàn mǎn le rén.
examples.english: This travel agency has a promotional event, so both inside and outside are full of people.

examples.chinese: 每到重大節日，城市裡就到處充滿了歡樂的氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào zhòngdà jiérì, chéngshì lǐ jiù dàochù chōngmǎn le huānlè de qìfēn.
examples.english: Whenever a major festival arrives, the city is filled everywhere with a joyful atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng méiyǒu zhǔrén de fángwū chōngmǎn kǒngbù de chuánshuō, yībān rén dōu bù yuànyì kàojìn.
examples.english: That house without an owner is full of terrifying legends; ordinary people are all unwilling to go near it.

items.wordHook: Water 氵(water) pours until it fills the container level to the brim → 滿(full).

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 不管未婚或者已婚的人，在現實生活中都有需要面對的問題。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn wèihūn huòzhě yǐhūn de rén, zài xiànshí shēnghuó zhōng dōu yǒu xūyào miànduì de wèntí.
examples.english: Whether unmarried or married, people all have problems they need to face in real life.

items.wordHook: Facing what is 現(appear) before you grounded in real 實(real) facts: 現實 means realistic.

examples.chinese: 開學典禮時校長所演講的內容又短又精彩，讓我印象很深。
examples.pinyin: Kāixué diǎnlǐ shí xiàozhǎng suǒ yǎnjiǎng de nèiróng yòu duǎn yòu jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yìnxiàng hěn shēn.
examples.english: The content of the principal's speech at the opening ceremony was both short and wonderful; it left a deep impression on me.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 這對情侶找了幾位朋友商量，一起安排結婚典禮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì qínglǚ zhǎo le jǐ wèi péngyou shāngliang, yīqǐ ānpái jiéhūn diǎnlǐ.
examples.english: This couple found several friends to consult with and together arrange their wedding ceremony.

examples.chinese: 學校的畢業典禮辦得很精彩，讓我們度過了愉快的一天。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bìyè diǎnlǐ bàn de hěn jīngcǎi, ràng wǒmen dùguò le yúkuài de yī tiān.
examples.english: The school's graduation ceremony was held wonderfully, allowing us to spend a happy day.

items.wordHook: Combining 之(of) and 後(after): 之後 means later.
Combining 休(rest) and 閒(leisure): 休閒 means leisure time.
Praying before the sacred 礻(spirit) shrine with a 畐(roll of cloth) full of gratitude brings lasting 福(happiness).
裡(inside) + 面(side) → the inside: 裡面 means in.
A 夫(man) must 見(see) the rules before acting → 規(rules).
郵(mail) + 件(item) → a mail item: 郵件(mail).
Combining 降(descend) and 低(low): 降低 means lower.
